max_open_trades.description: Maximum number of open trades. -1 for unlimited.

timeframe.description:
The timeframe to use (e.g `1m`, `5m`, `15m`, `30m`, `1h` ...). 
Usually specified in the strategy and missing in the configuration.

proxy_coin.description: Proxy coin - must be used for specific futures modes (e.g. BNFCR)

tradable_balance_ratio.description: Ratio of balance that is tradable.

amend_last_stake_amount.description: Whether to amend the last stake amount.

last_stake_amount_min_ratio.description: Minimum ratio for the last stake amount.

dry_run.description: Enable or disable dry run mode.

dry_run_wallet.description: Initial wallet balance for dry run mode.

minimal_roi.description:
Minimum return on investment. 
Usually specified in the strategy and missing in the configuration.

stoploss.description:
Value (as ratio) to use as Stoploss value. 
Usually specified in the strategy and missing in the configuration.

trailing_stop.description:
Enable or disable trailing stop. 
Usually specified in the strategy and missing in the configuration.

trailing_stop_positive.description:
Positive offset for trailing stop. 
Usually specified in the strategy and missing in the configuration.

trailing_stop_positive_offset.description:
Offset for trailing stop to activate. 
Usually specified in the strategy and missing in the configuration.

trailing_only_offset_is_reached.description:
Use trailing stop only when offset is reached. 
Usually specified in the strategy and missing in the configuration.

use_exit_signal.description:
Use exit signal for trades. 
Usually specified in the strategy and missing in the configuration.

exit_profit_only.description:
Exit only when in profit. Exit signals are ignored as long as profit is < exit_profit_offset. 
Usually specified in the strategy and missing in the configuration.

exit_profit_offset.description:
Offset for profit exit. 
Usually specified in the strategy and missing in the configuration.

strategy.description: Strategy class name (must be available in the user directory under strategies). Additional search paths can be added via strategy_path.

strategy_path.description: Additional lookup path for strategy classes.

user_data_dir.description: Path to the user data directory.

fee.description: Trading fee percentage. Can help to simulate slippage in backtesting

ignore_roi_if_entry_signal.description:
Ignore ROI if entry signal is present. 
Usually specified in the strategy and missing in the configuration.

ignore_buying_expired_candle_after.description:
Ignore buying after candle expiration time. 
Usually specified in the strategy and missing in the configuration.

reduce_df_footprint.description: Reduce DataFrame footprint by casting columns to float32/int32.

minimum_trade_amount.description: Minimum amount for a trade - only used for lookahead-analysis

targeted_trade_amount.description: Targeted trade amount for lookahead analysis.

lookahead_analysis_exportfilename.description: csv Filename for lookahead analysis export.

liquidation_warn_ratio.description: Notify when the distance to a position's liquidation stop falls below this fraction of the price move that would use up its margin - with the default of 0.2, once the stop is less than 2% away at 10x leverage. Set to 0 to disable.

backtest_cache.description: Load a cached backtest result no older than specified age.

hyperopt_path.description: Specify additional lookup path for Hyperopt Loss functions.

epochs.description: Number of training epochs for Hyperopt.

early_stop.description: Early stop hyperopt if no improvement after <epochs>. Set to 0 to disable.

spaces.description: Hyperopt parameter spaces to optimize. Default is the default set andincludes all spaces except for 'trailing', 'protection', and 'trades'.

analyze_per_epoch.description: Perform analysis after each epoch in Hyperopt.

print_all.description: Print all hyperopt trials, not just the best ones.

hyperopt_jobs.description: The number of concurrently running jobs for hyperoptimization (hyperopt worker processes). If -1 (default), all CPUs are used, for -2, all CPUs but one are used, etc. If 1 is given, no parallel computing is used.

hyperopt_min_trades.description: Minimum number of trades per epoch for hyperopt.

hyperopt_loss.description: The class name of the hyperopt loss function class (IHyperOptLoss). Different functions can generate completely different results, since the target for optimization is different. Built-in Hyperopt-loss-functions are: ShortTradeDurHyperOptLoss, OnlyProfitHyperOptLoss, SharpeHyperOptLoss, SharpeHyperOptLossDaily, SortinoHyperOptLoss, SortinoHyperOptLossDaily, CalmarHyperOptLoss, MaxDrawDownHyperOptLoss, MaxDrawDownRelativeHyperOptLoss, MaxDrawDownPerPairHyperOptLoss, ProfitDrawDownHyperOptLoss, MultiMetricHyperOptLoss

bot_name.description: Name of the trading bot. Passed via API to a client.

unfilledtimeout.description:
Timeout configuration for unfilled orders. 
Usually specified in the strategy and missing in the configuration.

entry.description: Timeout for entry orders in unit.

exit.description: Timeout for exit orders in unit.

exit_timeout_count.description: Number of times to retry exit orders before giving up.

unit.description: Unit of time for the timeout (e.g., seconds, minutes).

price_last_balance.description: Balance ratio for the last price.

price_side.description: Side of the price to use (e.g., bid, ask, same).

use_order_book.description: Whether to use the order book for pricing.

order_book_top.description: Top N levels of the order book to consider.

check_depth_of_market.description: Configuration for checking the depth of the market.

enabled.description: Enable or disable depth of market check.

bids_to_ask_delta.description: Delta between bids and asks to consider.

price_side.description: Side of the price to use (e.g., bid, ask, same).

price_last_balance.description: Balance ratio for the last price.

use_order_book.description: Whether to use the order book for pricing.

order_book_top.description: Top N levels of the order book to consider.

custom_price_max_distance_ratio.description: Maximum distance ratio between current and custom entry or exit price.

order_types.description:
Configuration of order types. 
Usually specified in the strategy and missing in the configuration.

entry.description: Order type for entry (e.g., limit, market).

exit.description: Order type for exit (e.g., limit, market).

force_exit.description: Order type for forced exit (e.g., limit, market).

force_entry.description: Order type for forced entry (e.g., limit, market).

emergency_exit.description: Order type for emergency exit (e.g., limit, market).

stoploss.description: Order type for stop loss (e.g., limit, market).

stoploss_on_exchange.description: Whether to place stop loss on the exchange.

stoploss_price_type.description: Price type for stop loss (e.g., last, mark, index).

stoploss_on_exchange_interval.description: Interval for stop loss on exchange in seconds.

stoploss_on_exchange_limit_ratio.description: Limit ratio for stop loss on exchange.

order_time_in_force.description:
Time in force configuration for orders. 
Usually specified in the strategy and missing in the configuration.

entry.description: Time in force for entry orders.

exit.description: Time in force for exit orders.

is_demo.description: Whether to use CoinGecko in demo mode.

method.description: Method used for generating the pairlist.

chat_id.description: Telegram chat or group ID. Recommended to be set via environment variable FREQTRADE__TELEGRAM__CHAT_ID

topic_id.description: Telegram topic ID - only applicable for group chats. Recommended to be set via environment variable FREQTRADE__TELEGRAM__TOPIC_ID

allow_custom_messages.description: Allow sending custom messages from the Strategy.

balance_dust_level.description: Minimum balance level to consider as dust.

notification_settings.description: Settings for different types of notifications.

entry_fill.description: Telegram setting for entry fill signals.

entry_cancel.description: Telegram setting for entry cancel signals.

exit_fill.description: Telegram setting for exit fill signals.

exit_cancel.description: Telegram setting for exit cancel signals.

protection_trigger_global.description: Telegram setting for global protection triggers.

reload.description: Add Reload button to certain messages.

enabled.description: Whether the API server is enabled.

listen_ip_address.description: IP address the API server listens on.

listen_port.description: Port the API server listens on.

process_throttle_secs.description: Minimum loop duration for one bot iteration in seconds.

position_adjustment_enable.description:
Enable position adjustment. 
Usually specified in the strategy and missing in the configuration.

new_pairs_days.description: Download data of new pairs for given number of days

download_trades.description: Download trades data by default (instead of ohlcv data).

max_entry_position_adjustment.description:
Maximum entry position adjustment allowed. 
Usually specified in the strategy and missing in the configuration.

cache_size.description: Size of the cache for order flow data.

max_candles.description: Maximum number of candles to consider.

scale.description: Scale factor for order flow data.

api_key.description: API key for the exchange. Recommended to be set via environment variable FREQTRADE__EXCHANGE__API_KEY

key.description: API key for the exchange. Recommended to be set via environment variable FREQTRADE__EXCHANGE__KEY Deprecated, use api_key instead.

secret.description: API secret for the exchange. Recommended to be set via environment variable FREQTRADE__EXCHANGE__SECRET

password.description: Password for the exchange, if required. Recommended to be set via environment variable FREQTRADE__EXCHANGE__PASSWORD

uid.description: User ID for the exchange, if required. Recommended to be set via environment variable FREQTRADE__EXCHANGE__UID

account_id.description: Account ID for the exchange, if required. Recommended to be set via environment variable FREQTRADE__EXCHANGE__ACCOUNT_ID

wallet_address.description: Wallet address for the exchange, if required. Usually used by DEX exchanges. Recommended to be set via environment variable FREQTRADE__EXCHANGE__WALLET_ADDRESS

private_key.description: Private key for the exchange, if required. Usually used by DEX exchanges. Recommended to be set via environment variable FREQTRADE__EXCHANGE__PRIVATE_KEY

log_responses.description: Log responses from the exchange.Useful/required to debug issues with order processing.

enable_ws.description: Enable WebSocket connections to the exchange. Either a boolean to enable/disable all streams, or an object for per-stream control (e.g. {"ohlcv": true, "orderbook": false}).

outdated_offset.description: Offset for outdated data in minutes.

markets_refresh_interval.description: Interval for refreshing market data in minutes.

live_candle_limit.description: Number of candles kept (and analyzed by the strategy) per pair in dry / live mode. Defaults to startup_candle_count + 500, at least 1000. Larger values are filled with multiple paged calls where the exchange provides history.

ccxt_config.description: CCXT configuration settings - applicable to both synchronous and asynchronous usage.

ccxt_async_config.description: CCXT asynchronous configuration settings. Usually ccxt_config should be used instead.

ccxt_sync_config.description: CCXT synchronous configuration settings. Usually ccxt_config should be used instead.
